description: Technology configurations for decarbonizing residential heat supply through district heating and implications for the electricity network (Dataset) is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Christian Doh Dinga, Sander van Rijn. Dataset for the default scenario of the paper "Technology configurations for decarbonizing residential heat supply through district heating and implications for the electricity network" by Doh Dinga et al. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
